nodes.title: The World's Yesterday/Today reads the ledger's secureSince (Learning, migration 046) instead of the device snapshot: a skill is new today when its stamp falls on today's local day, an unstamped secure skill is old; the device snapshot (rollSnapshot) stays only for a map with no stamps at all (046 not applied). Reverse: Learning drops secureSince.

md.decisions:
## `dc-r7-app-secure-since`
What became pakka today is now the ledger's fact, not one device's memory. A child who learns on the tablet sees the same 'new today' on the phone. Until the migration is applied everywhere, the device snapshot still fills in.
